# PhotoCapture

Adds one image (a crate photo of a record sleeve, artwork for a set) by taking a photo or choosing a file, then shows a square preview with Retake, Remove phot…

`SongNodes.PhotoCapture` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.PhotoCapture title={…} src={…} alt="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.PhotoCapture" title="{{…}}" src="{{…}}" alt="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (PhotoCaptureProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `{ lead: string; title: string }` | Title lead and title ("Crate photo: Add a sleeve"). |
| `src` * | `string \| null` | Current image (object URL or stored URL) or null. |
| `meta` | `string` | File name, size and time line under the actions. |
| `alt` * | `string` | Alt-text value. |
| `onAltChange` * | `(alt: string) => void` | Alt-text change. |
| `onImage` * | `(file: File) => void` | New image from camera or file (EXIF location removed before upload). |
| `onRemove` * | `() => void` | Remove the image. |
| `camera` | `boolean` | Show "Take photo" (rear camera on phones); default true when a camera is likely. |
| `maxMb` | `number` | Size limit in MB; default 10. |
